package.name: goal-meta-skill
package.upstream_inspiration: 向阳乔木 goal meta skill

upstream_sync.raw_exporter_role: diagnostic skeleton only; never the final repository artifact
upstream_sync.repo_native_enrichment: deterministic governed overlay followed by task-local non-empty assertions

intent.description: Use when the user explicitly asks to use Goal mode or to author, save, or manage a Goal for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Oh My Pi, or Kimi Code. Requests may say `/goal`, Goal 指令, 目标指令, Goal 模式, "用 Goal 模式完成", or "写成 Codex 目标指令"; the literal command is not required. Compile project-aware, verifiable Goal text, optionally save an approved root `GOAL.md` contract, or show the correct command for an existing Goal. After Goal intent is established, support Trellis implementation Goals, scan/review remediation Goals, and cross-session Goal handoffs.
intent.job_to_be_done: Use when the user explicitly asks to use Goal mode or to author, save, or manage a Goal for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Oh My Pi, or Kimi Code. Requests may say `/goal`, Goal 指令, 目标指令, Goal 模式, "用 Goal 模式完成", or "写成 Codex 目标指令"; the literal command is not required. Compile project-aware, verifiable Goal text, optionally save an approved root `GOAL.md` contract, or show the correct command for an existing Goal. After Goal intent is established, support Trellis implementation Goals, scan/review remediation Goals, and cross-session Goal handoffs.
inputs: explicit Goal-mode or Goal authoring, saving, or management request
outputs: reviewable DRAFT or APPROVED TEXT /goal contract
optional explicitly authorized root GOAL.md handoff, including same-turn creation
exclusions: second repair Prompt for same-scope findings

should_trigger: 用 Goal 模式完成这项工作，先写一个可审阅的目标。
把迁移计划写成 Claude Code Goal 指令。
Write a Codex /goal for the parser repair.
把已确认的 Goal 合同保存到项目根目录 GOAL.md。
管理 Codex 中现有的 Goal，告诉我如何暂停。
Compile a Codex /goal for one-Prompt remediation of a named scan report.
把 Trellis 审阅 findings 的修复写成单 Prompt Goal 指令。
把 review findings 修复编译成 Goal 指令，不要生成第二条修复 Prompt。
Persist an approved review-remediation contract as GOAL.md.
should_not_trigger: Directly fix the parser and run tests.
只读审阅报告，不要修改代码。
基于 dev 分支规划 lib 重构，创建供下个对话实施的 Prompt，暂不实施。
near_neighbor: Generate another repair Prompt after every review.
Use GOAL.md as a long-term memory vault.
Discuss possible scan strategies before choosing an outcome.

router_rules: Select this skill only for explicit Goal-mode use or Goal-specific authoring, saving, or management, including equivalent natural-language requests.
Treat Trellis implementation, scan/review remediation, and cross-session handoff as profiles only after Goal intent is established.
Select review-remediation only when a named review source and requested implementation are both present.
Keep read-only review and ordinary direct implementation on their own routes.
compact_workflow: select platform and load outcome-specific reference contracts
use defaults or bounded material-only interview
lint each payload through stdin or files, adding --review-remediation when selected
if explicitly authorized, persist the shown direct-child contract and verify read-back in the same turn
gate_ladder: stable finding ledger and bounded feedback
output_contract: One externally approved Prompt owns same-scope implementation and checking.
AskUserQuestion is limited to material user-owned decisions before first product write.
Round-cap or no-progress residuals end BLOCKED and never emit a second repair Prompt.
Ordinary completion requires deliverables, named-entry behavior, required checks and authorized diff/status together.
Saving supports only established-root direct-child Markdown basenames; nested legacy paths remain chat-only.

trust.file_write: one explicitly authorized direct-child Markdown through persist_goal_contract.py

permissions.reconnaissance: Read/Glob/Grep plus read-only git root, branch, and status probes
permissions.deterministic_helpers: run the bundled linter; write one explicitly authorized root Markdown only through persist_goal_contract.py
permissions.question_tool: not granted to goal-meta-skill; AskUserQuestion may appear only inside generated execution text
permissions.forbidden: Goal activation, payload implementation, agent dispatch, commit, archive, push, publish, install, and arbitrary file writes

degradation.openai: uses an explicit read ./GOAL.md objective; arbitrary GOAL.md is not auto-loaded
degradation.claude: uses @GOAL.md and requires transcript-visible evidence plus bounded stop-and-report
degradation.grok_build: uses an explicit read; @GOAL.md inside /goal and provider handoff remain UNVERIFIED
degradation.oh_my_pi: uses an explicit read and reports goal.enabled or plan/vibe conflicts; budget exhaustion is not completion
degradation.kimi_code: uses an explicit read; headless creation is separate and provider handoff remains UNVERIFIED
degradation.generic: asks for a concrete platform and keeps the contract chat-only when root or authorization is unclear

gates.review_before_activation: DRAFT or APPROVED TEXT only; present and stop
gates.review_remediation_profile: structured envelope, stable ledger, question exclusions, feedback edge, same-envelope zero-open completion, and residual BLOCKED state
gates.repo_validation: scripts/check.py, focused Node tests, Python byte compilation, docs sync/check, just ci, and git diff --check
gates.trigger_boundary: task-local Qiaomu cases because the repository forbids a second package eval schema
gates.qiaomu_schema_deviation: missing README.md, manifest.json, and package trigger schema remain missing evidence rather than a pass

evidence_boundary.generated_reports_are_evidence: only for the deterministic local gate they record
evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
